title: Difference Word Problems Within 20
intro: Teach a difference by matching two collections.
html:
Teaching notes for parents and teachers

How to teach it

Line up equal-sized counters in pairs and count the unmatched counters. Connect them to subtraction.

Ask your student

Which counters show how many more one group has?

If your student needs help

If the student gives the larger total, cover the matched pairs and discuss what remains unmatched.
